canonical_bytes.H: SHA256(tag_ASCII || 0x00 || for each field: uint64_be(byte_length) || field_bytes)
canonical_bytes.array_raw_hash: SHA-256 over exact C-order element bytes with no filename, shape prefix, NPY header, or LF
canonical_bytes.artifact_hash: SHA-256 over the complete exact artifact bytes
canonical_bytes.float_rules: finite IEEE-754 binary64 only in JSON score fields; parsed binary64 bits must equal recomputation; mathematical zero is encoded as +0.0 and -0.0 is rejected
canonical_bytes.integer_rules: range-check before encoding; counts and byte lengths are JSON integers; no float substitute
canonical_bytes.json: UTF-8 without BOM; object keys lexicographically sorted; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; allow_nan=false; duplicate keys forbidden; exactly one terminal LF
canonical_bytes.member_hash: SHA-256 over the complete exact NPY-v2.0 member bytes
canonical_bytes.npz: unique deterministic ZIP_STORED archive; flat ASCII member names with .npy suffix in bytewise ASCII order; NPY v2.0; allow_pickle=false; fixed DOS 1980-01-01 timestamp; flags, extra, comment, external attributes all zero; no duplicate, directory, encrypted, compressed, ZIP64, trailing, or extra member; load then reserialize must be byte-identical
canonical_bytes.receipt_hash: SHA-256 over the complete canonical JSON bytes including the single terminal LF

After the stability probe, never read the caller mapping again.
Validate only S, then canonicalize only that same S, then hash/consume those bytes. Validation of the caller object followed by later materialization is forbidden.

For every run in run order, before any teacher call, run the geometry-only two-stage integer_landmarks rule. If any run has fewer than three retained landmarks, immediately return ABSTAIN reasons [11] and create no natural-certificate-input receipt, teacher-output artifact, target artifact, or target receipt.
Within the same run, consecutive retained landmarks alone form ordered traversal edge bounds [L_j,L_(j+1)); no cross-run or nonconsecutive bound.

For each run independently compute F5 from continuous[149], edge_lengths, and these bounds. Visit traversals in order and subedges left-to-right; use normative Neumaier for every denominator and numerator. Mean term is lambda*((A+B)/2); second moment is lambda*(((A*A+A*B)+B*B)/3) in the written binary64 order. Equal-average traversal means/seconds with Neumaier; s=sqrt(max(qbar-mbar*mbar,+0.0)); concatenate [mbar,s] C-order <f8[298].

Cast each complete run static vector once to C-order <f4[298]. In run order issue one CPU float32 TempoRACTeacher forward for that run's exact <f4[Trun,215] input; no batch or padding. Use the exact environment, eval, inference_mode, one thread, no autocast/TF32.

Hash exact raw C-order float64 output bytes, build the unchanged natural-certificate-input receipt, bind the typed certificate track, run full certify_target, and either emit no target on ABSTAIN or the unchanged target NPZ/receipt on CERTIFIED.

teacher_tune_input.view_order: source_id 24 through 31 outer, block_index 0 through 6 inner; linear resampler and direct offset 0 only; view v=(source_id-24)*7+block_index

evaluation_execution: For every checkpoint, load through the strict checkpoint loader and load the independently rebuilt-and-byte-verified shared tune-input artifact.

Visit views v=0 through 55. For each view issue exactly one CPU float32 forward call using teacher_input[sample_offsets[v]:sample_offsets[v+1]] and static_features[v]. No cross-view batch, padding, or cached output is allowed.
Use eval plus inference_mode, one intra-op thread, one inter-op thread, no autocast/TF32, and the exact environment lock.
Concatenate output rows only in view/sample order into the exact two-member output NPZ. Require shapes, C order, finiteness, deterministic reserialization, raw payload, and 16 MiB cap.

The full typed X0 track for each view is reconstructed from tune input plus that checkpoint output. Every tune abstention invokes the complete certify_target path, including analytic chi/pulse equality; the analytic certificate_track shortcut is forbidden.

evaluation_receipt.independence: This receipt is built from the recomputed output artifact and score arithmetic, not copied from the score index. Its hash is the authority-bearing provenance named by one score row.

correspondence: For each nonreference block 1 through 6, evaluate the 128 fractions (j+1/2)/128 in j order against block 0 using F9 inversion, right-tie ownership, shortest signed principal-arc interpolation, and term 1-dot.
Neumaier equal-average fraction, traversal, nonreference block, then source_id in that order.
exact_reductions.domains: tune_abstentions is an integer in [0,56]; negative_edge_fraction is finite in [0,1]; mean_masked_reconstruction and tune_objective are finite, nonnegative binary64; every computed zero is canonical +0.0.
exact_reductions.negative_edge_fraction: Count, with integer arithmetic, every traversal-owned valid edge whose increment is strictly less than -1e-12 and divide once in binary64 by the positive integer count of all traversal-owned valid edges. Do not average ratios by view.
exact_reductions.neumaier: For ordered binary64 terms x: t=s+x; compensation adds (s-t)+x when abs(s)>=abs(x), otherwise (x-t)+s; final value s+compensation. Empty or nonpositive denominator fails.
phase_penalties: A traversal owns edges e=left through right-1 exactly once. Valid means the existing F11 observed-retained-edge predicate holds and both normalized phase endpoints are finite.
For each owned valid edge in increasing e, compute the F11 signed principal increment in cycles. Neumaier-average edge, traversal, block, then source.
orientation is mean ReLU(-increment); alias is mean ReLU(abs(increment)-0.25).
reconstruction: Use F11 Huber delta 0.05 against the exact first 149 tune-input channels and their masks derived from the last 66 teacher-input mask channels.
Within each traversal, sample indices increase; at each sample channels 0 through 148 are the innermost order. Neumaier-sum only masked channel losses and divide by the positive integer mask count.
Neumaier equal-average traversal 0 through 9, then block 0 through 6, then source_id 24 through 31. This value is mean_masked_reconstruction and is exactly the F11 L_rec on the tune inventory.
exact_reductions.tune_abstentions: Count integer ABSTAIN results from full certify_target over all 56 views. Partial checks, phase-only checks, analytic phase/reconstruction, or certificate_track are not tune outputs.
exact_reductions.tune_objective: The complete F11 value is L_rec + L_corr + 0.25*orientation + 0.25*alias in that written binary64 operation order.

tune_output_and_scoring.typed_view_reconstruction: For view v, continuous is teacher_input slice columns 0:149 cast once to C-order <f8; continuous_mask is geometry element mask from columns 149:182 repeated over x/y for channels 0:66, direction element mask from 182:215 repeated over x/y for 66:132, and geometry element-mask entries 0:17 for confidence 132:149. Samples/clocks use sample_offsets, analytic edges use edge_offsets, and traversal bounds use row v. No caller field participates.
